title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
abstract: arXiv:2611.17929v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific literature search can benefit from locally deployed LLM assistants, which reduce reliance on hosted model providers while giving research teams greater control over their data and infrastructure. This work investigates whether open-weight models can support web-assisted paper retrieval under practical computing constraints. We first characterize inference latency as the input context grows from 512 to 128k tokens on a Mac Studio and a server equipped with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We then evaluate eight models on the retrieval of 70 papers from seven scientific repositories, using queries that represent three levels of domain knowledge. The results show that retrieval success depends strongly on the selected model and the specificity of the query. And that A100 GPUs are generally faster than the Mac Studio, but its unified memory allows larger models that could not be loaded in the tested GPU configuration.

translated_title: 评估大型语言模型在科学论文搜索中的应用：Mac Studio与NVIDIA A100上的检索成功率与推理延迟
translated_abstract: 科学文献检索可以从本地部署的大语言模型（LLM）助手中受益，这类助手减少了对托管模型提供商的依赖，同时让研究团队对自身数据和基础设施拥有更大的控制权。本研究探讨了开放权重模型能否在实际计算约束下支持网络辅助的论文检索。我们首先在Mac Studio和配备两块NVIDIA A100 GPU的服务器上，表征了输入上下文从512个token增长到128k个token过程中的推理延迟。随后，我们使用代表三个不同领域知识水平的查询，评估了八个模型对来自七个科学存储库的70篇论文的检索能力。结果表明，检索成功率在很大程度上取决于所选模型和查询的具体程度。此外，A100 GPU通常比Mac Studio更快，但Mac Studio的统一内存允许加载在所测试的GPU配置中无法装载的更大模型。
tldr: 本研究在Mac Studio与NVIDIA A100上评估了八个开放权重大语言模型执行科学论文网络辅助检索的表现，发现检索成功率主要取决于模型选择与查询的具体性，A100推理速度更快，但Mac Studio的统一内存可支持更大的模型。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates eight open-weight LLMs for web-assisted scientific paper retrieval on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100, showing that retrieval success depends strongly on model choice and query specificity, with A100s generally faster while Mac Studio's unified memory enables loading larger models.
